Subject: Reseller channel private-offer onboarding checklist & pricing bands

Hi Laura —

Thanks again for taking the call this morning. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a short onboarding checklist for the AWS Marketplace private offer pilot and outline the pricing & term bands we typically use for channel/reseller pilots. This should help your procurement and legal team triage quickly.

1) Pricing bands (pilot-only, non-binding guidance)
   - Pilot band A: 0-25k USD committed spend — list price (no resell discount)
   - Pilot band B: 25k-150k USD — channel discount tier 10-20% (depends on ARR signal)
   - Pilot band C: 150k+ — negotiated discount (20%+), consider annual term

2) Term options (we recommend starting short for pilots)
   - 30-day pilot (activation + initial usage window)
   - 90-day staged pilot (recommended for multi-account testing)
   - 12-month commitment (for production/entitlements)

3) Buyer approvals we need mapped from your side
   - Technical approver (cloud infra lead)
   - Procurement (PO issuer + standard T&Cs contact)
   - Finance / CFO (if commit > 150k)

4) Evidence pack to accelerate approval (attached)
   - SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, activation SLAs, proposed PO template

5) Next steps / ask
   - Can you share the names/emails for procurement and technical approver?
   - If you want an auto-approve path for pilot band B (<= 20% discount), confirm procurement email and we can pre-fill AWS private offer with that approver.

Attachments: redwood_po_template_v2.pdf, procurement-evidence-checklist.xlsx

I'll loop in Priyom (solutions) for the multi-account activation steps once we have approvers.

Best,

Laura — thanks for the questions. Inline answers below.

> Does Redwood require a separate AWS account per buyer for activation, or can we route through a master account?
You can route through a master account for pilot activation (we support multi-account mappings in the private offer). For production/entitlements we recommend buyers onboard their own AWS accounts, but for a short staged pilot a master reseller account is fine. We will include activation GUIDs per buyer.

> For Pilot band B (10-20%): what are the exact auto-approve criteria?
Auto-approve for channel pilot band B requires: signed PO (PDF) on company letterhead + procurement contact listed in the PO + SOC2 attestation (summary) included in the evidence pack. If all three are present we can pre-approve up to 20% discount without additional legal review; anything beyond 20% triggers legal.

> Multi-site 90-day staged pilot — OK?
Yes. Recommend staggered activations (week 0 / week 4 / week 8) so we can validate KV cache behavior across accounts. Priyom, can you add the brief activation checklist for multi-account staging?
